CreateL3MountTarget.action: Fixed value for this API: CreateL3MountTarget
CreateL3MountTarget.vpcId: Short ID of the VPC to which the PFS instance VIP belongs
CreateL3MountTarget.subnetId: Subnet to which the MountTarget belongs; must be within the VPC of the PFS instance, short ID format
CreateL3MountTarget.name: Mount target name, default is "default"
CreateL3MountTarget.accessGroupName: Access group name, default is DEFAULT_ACCESS_GROUP_NAME
CreateL3MountTarget.protocol: Protocol type, default is bpfs, currently only bpfs/nfs are supported
